dogecoin.text: I strongly believe Dogecoin is significantly undervalued! 🐶 It's an "ash-level" project like Bitcoin due to its long-standing presence, high visibility (thanks, Elon!), and decentralized nature. I've recently taken a long position on DOGE. #DOGE
